name: DataMentor
author: AuburnForest

sections.description:
DataMentor is an Elementor add-on that lets you build and showcase data tables in a clean, tabular format without writing any code. It’s a simple and flexible way to present your data analysis or listings with the help of the Elementor page builder.

Add unlimited rows and columns, and mix content types per cell – plain text, rich text, an Elementor template, or a call-to-action button. Style every part of the table, including headers, borders, colors, spacing, and typography, directly from the Elementor Style tab.

Features

We have researched all basic requirements to present anything with Data Tables.

You can create and manage tables from the admin panel quickly, effectively and easily.

Documentation and Support

  • If you have any more questions, visit our support on the Plugin’s Forum.

Note: This plugin is a widget of Elementor Page Builder and will only work with Elementor Page Builder installed.

Like Datamentor Plugin?

  • Don’t forget to leave us a review on WordPress 🙂
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
Can I add multiple Datamentor widgets with single page?

Yes, you can. DataMentor plugin gives you the ability to add multiple Data Tables on same page. You just need to drag and drop that module multiple times and input different data values whatever you want to showcase.

Can I showcase button too instead of text input only?

Yes, You can. We have provided button input value too that will be helpful to showcase button instead of text with data tables.
